image_description: A close-up view of a polished steel breastplate (cuirass) featuring ornate etched designs and gilded accents. The armor has a raised center ridge, curved anatomical contours, and visible attachment points/straps at the shoulders. It is positioned among other historical artifacts, including what appears to be a helmet or spherical object with a band in the foreground.

selected_experts.reason: To verify the specific type of armor and distinguish it from similar classes like 'cuirass' or generic 'armor'.
To analyze the realism of the reflections and ensure no texture anomalies or melting artifacts on the polished surface.
To ensure the boundaries of the armor are sharp and physically connected, checking for edge bleeding into the background clutter.
To verify the spatial relationship between the breastplate and the foreground/background objects (helmet/spheres).

focus_areas: Reflection consistency on curved metal surfaces
Physical plausibility of shoulder strap attachments
Boundary separation from complex background clutter
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflections on the metal surface; AI often fails to render coherent environmental reflections on complex curved mirrors. Verify that the etched patterns do not 'melt' or lose definition near the edges of the plate. Check if the shoulder straps appear physically attached or if they float/fuse with the metal.
